verses.sloka: तद् वचः पथ्यम् अक्लीबम् सारणेन अभिभाषितम् ।निशम्य रावणो राजा प्रत्यभाषत सारणम् ॥६-२६-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: tad vacaḥ pathyam aklībam sāraṇena abhibhāṣitam ।niśamya rāvaṇo rājā pratyabhāṣata sāraṇam ॥6-26-1॥।।

translations.english: Perceiving the truthful and beneficial words spoken by Saarana, without hesitation, King Ravana replied.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का पच्चीसवोँ सग पूरा हुआ । —B— $ र “Rf षड्विशःसगः _ न | तद्वचः पथ्यमक्लीबं सारणेनाभिभाषितम्‌ । निशम्य रावणो राजा प्रत्यभाषत सारणम्‌

verses.sloka: यदि माम् अभियुन्जीरन् देव गन्धर्व दानवाः ।न एव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्व लोक भयाद् अपि ॥६-२६-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: yadi mām abhiyunjīran deva gandharva dānavāḥ ।na eva sītām pradāsyāmi sarva loka bhayād api ॥6-26-2॥।।

translations.english: "Even if Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas put together attack me in war and not even for the fear of the whole world will I surrender Sita?"
translations.hindi: हू षड्विंशः सगः २१६ यदि देवता, गन्धव और दानव मेरे ऊपर चढ़ाई करें, अथवा समस्त लोक ही मेरे विरुद्ध हो जाय, तो भी में भयभीत हो कभी सीता राम को।न दूंगा

verses.sloka: त्वम् तु सौम्य परित्रस्तो हरिभिर् निर्जितो भृशम् ।प्रतिप्रदानम् अद्य एव सीतायाः साधु मन्यसे ॥६-२६-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: tvam tu saumya paritrasto haribhir nirjito bhṛśam ।pratipradānam adya eva sītāyāḥ sādhu manyase ॥6-26-3॥।।

translations.english: As you are vanquished by the noble Vanaras you are frightened like this and thinking it is good to surrender Sita.
translations.hindi: हे सौम्य ! तुम तो वानरों से कष्ट पा कर डर गए हो । इसी से तो तुम आज ही सीता को लौटा देना अच्छा समझते हो

verses.sloka: को हि नाम सपत्नो माम् समरे जेतुम् अर्हति ।इति उक्त्वा परुषम् वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ॥६-२६-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: ko hi nāma sapatno mām samare jetum arhati ।iti uktvā paruṣam vākyam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ ॥6-26-4॥।।

translations.english: "What adversary can win me in war? You ought to know this", said Ravana. Then Ravana, the king of Rakshasas having spoken that way went up to the snow white palace which was of the height of many Palmira trees wishing to see (the Vanaras).
translations.hindi: ऐसा कौन शत्र है, जो मुझे युद्ध में जीत सके । राक्षासराज रावण, इस प्रकार के कठोर वचन कह

verses.sloka: आरुरोह ततः श्रीमान् प्रासादम् हिम पाण्डुरम् ।बहु ताल समुत्सेधम् रावणो अथ दिदृक्षया ॥६-२६-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: āruroha tataḥ śrīmān prāsādam hima pāṇḍuram ।bahu tāla samutsedham rāvaṇo atha didṛkṣayā ॥6-26-5॥।।

translations.english: "What adversary can win me in war? You ought to know this", said Ravana. Then Ravana, the king of Rakshasas having spoken that way went up to the snow white palace which was of the height of many Palmira trees wishing to see (the Vanaras).

verses.sloka: ताभ्याम् चराभ्याम् सहितो रावणः क्रोध मूर्चितः ।पश्यमानः समुद्रम् च पर्वतामः च वनानि च ॥६-२६-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tābhyām carābhyām sahito rāvaṇaḥ krodha mūrcitaḥ ।paśyamānaḥ samudram ca parvatāmaḥ ca vanāni ca ॥6-26-6॥।।

translations.english: Deluded with anger Ravana along with both the spies observed the sea, the mountains and the woods crowded with monkeys in that region of the earth.
translations.hindi: सपना शब: । (गोऽ) १, पृषिवीदेश = िकूदाषः प्रदेश (गो०) २२०” युद्धकाण्डे . - उस समय रावण बड़ा कुपित था और उसके साथ वे दोनों रात्तसदूत झुक और सारणा भी थे । उस अटारी से उसने समुद्र नन, त्रिकूटाचल्ल पत की तराई और पहाड़ों पर बंदर ही बंदर देखे । उसने उस अपार असंख्य और बड़े बलवान्‌ बानरों की सेना को देखा

verses.sloka: ददर्श पृथिवी देशम् सुसम्पूर्णम् प्लवम् गमैः ।तद् अपारम् असम्ख्येयम् वानराणाम् महद् बलम् ॥६-२६-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: dadarśa pṛthivī deśam susampūrṇam plavam gamaiḥ ।tad apāram asamkhyeyam vānarāṇām mahad balam ॥6-26-7॥।।

translations.english: Ravana seeing the innumerable army force of monkeys which was impossible to count again enquired looking at Saarana.

verses.sloka: आलोक्य रावणो राजा परिपप्रच्च सारणम् ।एषाम् वानर मुख्यानाम् के शूराः के महाबलाः ॥६-२६-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: ālokya rāvaṇo rājā paripapracca sāraṇam ।eṣām vānara mukhyānām ke śūrāḥ ke mahābalāḥ ॥6-26-8॥।।

translations.english: "Who among the Vanaras is foremost, who is valiant, strong in prowess and most energetic? Who are their equals in the earlier war, you may tell in order?"
translations.hindi: ॥ आलोक्य राबणो राजा परिपप्रच्छ सारणम्‌ । ` एषां वानरशुख्यानां के शूराः के महाबलाः ॥ ८ ` उस सेना का अवलोकन कर, रावण सारण से पूछने लगा । इन वानरों में कौन कौन मुख्य, कौन कोन वीर और बड़े बड़े बलवान्‌ हैं १

verses.sloka: के पूर्वम् अभिवर्तन्ते महाउत्साहाः समन्ततः ।केषाम् शृणोति सुग्रीवः के वा यूथप यूथपाः ॥६-२६-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: ke pūrvam abhivartante mahāutsāhāḥ samantataḥ ।keṣām śṛṇoti sugrīvaḥ ke vā yūthapa yūthapāḥ ॥6-26-9॥।।

translations.english: "Whose advice does Sugriva listen to? Who is the chief of the army of Vanaras? Saarana, I wish to know truly."

verses.sloka: सारण आचक्ष्व मे सर्वम् के प्रधानाः प्लवम् गमाः ।सारणो राक्षस इन्द्रस्य वचनम् परिपृच्चतः ॥६-२६-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: sāraṇa ācakṣva me sarvam ke pradhānāḥ plavam gamāḥ ।sāraṇo rākṣasa indrasya vacanam paripṛccataḥ ॥6-26-10॥।।

translations.english: Hearing the words asked by Rakshasendra, Saarana, who knew the important ones, thus spoke out about the important monkey leaders.
translations.hindi: हे सारण ! तुम ठीक ठीक बतलाओ कि इस वानरी सेना में प्रधान वानर कौन कौन है ! राक्षसराज रावण के इन प्रश्नों को सुन

verses.sloka: आचचक्षे अथ मुख्यज्ञो मुख्याम्स् ताम्स् तु वन ओकसः ।एष यो अभिमुखो लंकाम् नर्दम्स् तिष्ठति वानरः ॥६-२६-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: ācacakṣe atha mukhyajño mukhyāms tāms tu vana okasaḥ ।eṣa yo abhimukho laṁkām nardams tiṣṭhati vānaraḥ ॥6-26-11॥।।

translations.english: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."
translations.hindi: क पाठान्तरे--“मुख्यांस्तांस्तु >) FP षड्वशः सगः २२१. मुख्य अमुख्य वानर बीरों को जानने वाला सारण, मुख्य बानरों के नाम, धाम, बल, बिक्रम का निरूपण करके कहने लगा । बह बोला-हे रावण ! यह वानर जो लङ्का की ओर मुख कर गरज रहा है.

verses.sloka: यूथपानाम् सहस्राणाम् शतेन परिवारितः ।यस्य घोषेण महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा ॥६-२६-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: yūthapānām sahasrāṇām śatena parivāritaḥ ।yasya ghoṣeṇa mahatā saprākārā satoraṇā ॥6-26-12॥।।

translations.english: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."
translations.hindi: इसके साथ एक लाख वानर यूथपति हैं । इसके सिंहनाद परकोटे, तोरण द्वारों

verses.sloka: लंका प्रवेपते सर्वा सशैल वन कानना ।सर्व शाखा मृग इन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ॥६-२६-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: laṁkā pravepate sarvā saśaila vana kānanā ।sarva śākhā mṛga indrasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ॥6-26-13॥।।

translations.english: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."
translations.hindi: पहाड़ों, वनों और उपवनो सहित समस्त लक्का कॉप रही है. आर जो समस्त वानरों के राजा महाबुद्धिमान्‌ सुग्रीव

verses.sloka: बल अग्रे तिष्ठते वीरो नीलो नाम एष यूथपः ।बाहू प्रगृह्य यः पद्भ्याम् महीम् गच्चति वीर्यवान् ॥६-२६-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: bala agre tiṣṭhate vīro nīlo nāma eṣa yūthapaḥ ।bāhū pragṛhya yaḥ padbhyām mahīm gaccati vīryavān ॥6-26-14॥।।

translations.english: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
translations.hindi: की सेना के आगे खड़ा है इसका नाम नील है और यह बडा. बीर और यूथपति है । जो बलवान वानर बाँहों को उठाए, प्रथिवी . हर टहल रहा है

verses.sloka: लंकाम् अभिमुखः कोपाद् अभीक्ष्णम् च विजृम्भते ।गिरि शृन्ग प्रतीकाशः पद्म किन्जल्क सम्निभः ॥६-२६-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: laṁkām abhimukhaḥ kopād abhīkṣṇam ca vijṛmbhate ।giri śṛnga pratīkāśaḥ padma kinjalka samnibhaḥ ॥6-26-15॥।।

translations.english: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
translations.hindi: यह न तो मरने से डरता है ओर न युद्ध से मढ मोडता है। यह मारे क्रोध के थर थर कॉप रहा है और तिरी दृष्टि से देख रहा है । देखिए, पूछ फटकार कर कैसा सिंहनाद कर रहा है तथा अपने बल विक्रम पर निर्भर रह कर, निर्भय हो साल्वेय नामक रमणीय पहाड़ पर रहता है

verses.sloka: स्फोटयति अभिसम्रब्धो लान्गूलम् च पुनः पुनः ।यस्य लान्गूल शब्देन स्वनन्ति इव दिशो दश ॥६-२६-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: sphoṭayati abhisamrabdho lāngūlam ca punaḥ punaḥ ।yasya lāngūla śabdena svananti iva diśo daśa ॥6-26-16॥।।

translations.english: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
translations.hindi: ओर जो क्रोघ में भर अपनी पूछ बारंबार प्रथिवी पर पटक रहा है और जिसकी पूंछ की फटकार के शब्द से दर्सो. दिखाएँ प्रतिध्वनित हो रही हैं

verses.sloka: एष वानर राजेन सुर्ग्रीवेण अभिषेचितः ।यौवराज्ये अन्गदो नाम त्वाम् आह्वयति सम्युगे ॥६-२६-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa vānara rājena surgrīveṇa abhiṣecitaḥ ।yauvarājye angado nāma tvām āhvayati samyuge ॥6-26-17॥।।

translations.english: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."
translations.hindi: सो यह अंगद नाम का वानर है । इसे कपिराज सुग्रीव ने यौत्रराञ्यपद पर अभिषिक्त किया हे ओर यह तुमको युद्ध के लिये ललकार रहा है

verses.sloka: वालिनः सदृशः पुत्रः सुग्रीवस्य सदा प्रियः ।राघवार्थे पराक्रान्तः शक्रार्थे वरुणो यथा ॥६-२६-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: vālinaḥ sadṛśaḥ putraḥ sugrīvasya sadā priyaḥ ।rāghavārthe parākrāntaḥ śakrārthe varuṇo yathā ॥6-26-18॥।।

translations.english: "He is the son of Vali and is similar to him and is ever beloved of Sugriva. Jus t like Varuna fights for the cause of Indra, he is ready to show his valour for the cause of Rama."
translations.hindi: यह बालि का पुत्र अङ्गद अपने पिता के समान बलवाने ओर पराक्रमी हे और सुग्रोब का सदा 'प्रिय पात्र है । जिस प्रकार वरुण जी इन्द्र के लिए पराक्रम प्रदर्शित करने को उद्यत रहते हैं ; उसी प्रकार यह भी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के लिए पराक्रम दिखाने को तत्पर रहता है

verses.sloka: एतस्य सा मतिः सर्वा यद्दृष्टा जनकात्मजा ।हनूमता वेगवता राघवस्य हितैषिणा ॥६-२६-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: etasya sā matiḥ sarvā yaddṛṣṭā janakātmajā ।hanūmatā vegavatā rāghavasya hitaiṣiṇā ॥6-26-19॥।।

translations.english: "He is a well wisher of Raghava, called Hanuman. He had come to see Janaka's daughter, and his intellect is the cause for all that."

verses.sloka: बहूनि वानरेन्द्राणामेष यूथानि वीर्यवान् ।परिगृह्याभियाति त्वाम् स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: bahūni vānarendrāṇāmeṣa yūthāni vīryavān ।parigṛhyābhiyāti tvām svenānīkena marditum ॥6-26-20॥।।

translations.english: "This valiant Vanara himself with many troops and several battalions of the Vanara king is marching to crush you."
translations.hindi: बलवान्‌ अङ्गद असंख्य वानस्यूथर्पातयों के साथ तुम्हारा मर्दन करने को आगे बढ़ा आता है. । यह दुर्जेय है

verses.sloka: अनुवालिसुतस्यापि बलेन महता वृतः ।वीरस्तिष्ठति सम्ग्रामे सेतुहेतुरयम् नलः ॥६-२६-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: anuvālisutasyāpi balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।vīrastiṣṭhati samgrāme setuheturayam nalaḥ ॥6-26-21॥।।

translations.english: "Behind this Vali's son is Nala surrounded by a huge army force. He is heroic in war. He is the cause of construction of the bridge."
translations.hindi: जिस वीर ने समुद्र के ऊपर पुल बाँधा है, वह नल नामक बीर वानर लड़ने की अभिलाषा करता हुआ बढ़ी भारी सेना के साथ बालिसुत अङ्गद के पीछे खड़ा हुआ है

verses.sloka: ये तु विष्टभ्य गात्राणि क्ष्वेडयन्ति नदन्ति च ।उत्थाय च विजृम्भन्ते क्रोधेन हरि पुम्गवाः ॥६-२६-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: ye tu viṣṭabhya gātrāṇi kṣveḍayanti nadanti ca ।utthāya ca vijṛmbhante krodhena hari pumgavāḥ ॥6-26-22॥।।

translations.english: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. They have made their body stiff, tossing their limbs, and are roaring in anger. They are standing up and stretching their limbs in sandalwood forest. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."
translations.hindi: ये जो कपिश्रेष्ठ अपने अङ्कां को मल मल कर, ,सिहनाद करते हुए गरज रहे हैं. तथा उचक कर क्रोध में भर जमुहा रहे हैं.

verses.sloka: एते दुष्प्रसहा घोराः चण्डाः चण्ड पराक्रमाः ।अष्टौ शत सहस्राणि दश कोटि शतानि च ॥६-२६-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: ete duṣprasahā ghorāḥ caṇḍāḥ caṇḍa parākramāḥ ।aṣṭau śata sahasrāṇi daśa koṭi śatāni ca ॥6-26-23॥।।

translations.english: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. They have made their body stiff, tossing their limbs, and are roaring in anger. They are standing up and stretching their limbs in sandalwood forest. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."
translations.hindi: ये सब शत्रओं के लिये असह्य और प्रचण्ड पराक्रमी हैं.। इनकी संख्या एक खर्व आठ लाख हे

verses.sloka: य एनम् अनुगच्चन्ति वीराः चन्दन वासिनः ।एष आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: ya enam anugaccanti vīrāḥ candana vāsinaḥ ।eṣa āśamsate laṁkām svena anīkena marditum ॥6-26-24॥।।

translations.english: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. They have made their body stiff, tossing their limbs, and are roaring in anger. They are standing up and stretching their limbs in sandalwood forest. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."
translations.hindi: सेतुहेतु:--सेठुकत्ता । (गो०) २ चज ला र विश्व-उसम्नन्य ।( गे | (गार ) ३ श्राशंसते प्राथ॑यते | ( गो० ) २२४ युद्धकाण्डे उनके पीछे जो वीर वानर हें, वे सत्र चन्दनवन “निवासी हैं, ये अपनी सेना द्वारा लङ्का को ध्वस्त करने की आज्ञा पाने के लिए प्राथना करते हैं

verses.sloka: श्वेतो रजत सम्काशः सबलो भीम विक्रमः ।बुद्धिमान् वानरः शूरस् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ॥६-२६-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: śveto rajata samkāśaḥ sabalo bhīma vikramaḥ ।buddhimān vānaraḥ śūras triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ॥6-26-25॥।।

translations.english: "One who resembles silver in colour is Swetha. He is an intelligent one with terrific prowess, and a warrior is well known in the three worlds. Swetha is quickly coming towards Sugriva, dividing the Vanara army forces and again proceeding swiftly."

verses.sloka: तूर्णम् सुग्रीवम् आगम्य पुनर् गच्चति वानरः ।विभजन् वानरीम् सेनाम् अनीकानि प्रहर्षयन् ॥६-२६-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tūrṇam sugrīvam āgamya punar gaccati vānaraḥ ।vibhajan vānarīm senām anīkāni praharṣayan ॥6-26-26॥।।

translations.english: "One who resembles silver in colour is Swetha. He is an intelligent one with terrific prowess, and a warrior is well known in the three worlds. Swetha is quickly coming towards Sugriva, dividing the Vanara army forces and again proceeding swiftly."
translations.hindi: देखिए, कैसी शीघ्रता से सुग्रीव कें पास जाता और लौट आता है । जो वानरी सेना को विभाजित कर रहा है, जो अपनी सेना को प्रसन्न कर रहा है

verses.sloka: यः पुरा गोमती तीरे रम्यम् पर्येति पर्वतम् ।नाम्ना सम्कोचनो नाम नाना नग युतो गिरिः ॥६-२६-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: yaḥ purā gomatī tīre ramyam paryeti parvatam ।nāmnā samkocano nāma nānā naga yuto giriḥ ॥6-26-27॥।।

translations.english: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."
translations.hindi: जो पहिले गोमती तटवर्ती रमणीक पवत के चारों ओर घूमा करता था, तथा अब अनेक पर्वों से घिरे हुए सङ्कोचन नामक पर्वत पर राज्य करता है । इसका नास कुमुद है और यह भी एक यूथपति दै । यह एक लाख वानर लेकर आया हुआ है

verses.sloka: तत्र राज्यम् प्रशास्ति एष कुमुदो नाम यूथपः ।यो असौ शत सहस्राणाम् सहस्रम् परिकर्षति ॥६-२६-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatra rājyam praśāsti eṣa kumudo nāma yūthapaḥ ।yo asau śata sahasrāṇām sahasram parikarṣati ॥6-26-28॥।।

translations.english: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

verses.sloka: यस्य वाला बहु व्यामा दीर्घ लान्गूलम् आश्रिताः ।ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः प्रकीर्णा घोर कर्मणः ॥६-२६-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: yasya vālā bahu vyāmā dīrgha lāngūlam āśritāḥ ।tāmrāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śvetāḥ prakīrṇā ghora karmaṇaḥ ॥6-26-29॥।।

translations.english: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

verses.sloka: अदीनो रोषणः चण्डः सम्ग्रामम् अभिकान्क्षति ।एष एव आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: adīno roṣaṇaḥ caṇḍaḥ samgrāmam abhikānkṣati ।eṣa eva āśamsate laṁkām svena anīkena marditum ॥6-26-30॥।।

translations.english: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

verses.sloka: यस् त्व् एष सिम्ह सम्काशः कपिलो दीर्घ केसरः ।निभृतः प्रेक्षते लंकाम् दिधक्षन्न् इव चक्षुषा ॥६-२६-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: yas tv eṣa simha samkāśaḥ kapilo dīrgha kesaraḥ ।nibhṛtaḥ prekṣate laṁkām didhakṣann iva cakṣuṣā ॥6-26-31॥।।

translations.english: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."
translations.hindi: जो अदीन हे और बड़ा क्रोधी है इसका नाम चण्ड है. । यह बड़ा संग्रामप्रिय हे । यह भी अपनी सेना को साथ ले लङ्काको ध्वस्त करने की आज्ञा पाने के लिए सुम्रीव से प्राथना करता है ३०। यस्त्वेप सिंहसङ्काशः कपिलो दीपकेसर ¦ । निभृतः१ प्र चते लङ्कां दिधचन्निब चक्षुषा

verses.sloka: विन्ध्यम् कृष्ण गिरिम् सह्यम् पर्वतम् च सुदर्शनम् ।राजन् सततम् अध्यास्ते रम्भो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२६-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: vindhyam kṛṣṇa girim sahyam parvatam ca sudarśanam ।rājan satatam adhyāste rambho nāma eṣa yūthapaḥ ॥6-26-32॥।।

translations.english: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."
translations.hindi: ओर जिसका विन्ध्य, ऋष्णगिरि, सह्या द्र तुझा सुदर्शन नामक तीन परढीतों पर रहने का स्थान है ; हे राजन्‌! वह रम्भ नाम का यूथपति हे.

verses.sloka: शतम् शत सहस्राणाम् त्रिम्शच् च हरि यूथपाः ।यम् यान्तम् वानरा घोराश्चण्डाश्चण्ड्पराक्रमाः ॥६-२६-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: śatam śata sahasrāṇām trimśac ca hari yūthapāḥ ।yam yāntam vānarā ghorāścaṇḍāścaṇḍparākramāḥ ॥6-26-33॥।।

translations.english: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."
translations.hindi: इसको एक करोड़ तीस प्रचण्ड शूरवीर और पराक्रमी वनर घेर कर चलते हैं। यह भो अपने पराक्रम से लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चाहता है । देखो, यह जो अपने कानों को सकोड़ता और बार बार जँभाई लेता है

verses.sloka: परिवार्य अनुगच्चन्ति लंकाम् मर्दितुम् ओजसा ।यस् तु कर्णौ विवृणुते जृम्भते च पुनः पुनः ॥६-२६-३४॥।।
verses.transliteration: parivārya anugaccanti laṁkām marditum ojasā ।yas tu karṇau vivṛṇute jṛmbhate ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥6-26-34॥।।

translations.english: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."

verses.sloka: न च सम्विजते मृत्योर् न च यूथाद् विधावति ।प्रकम्पते च रोषेन तिर्यक्च पुनरीक्षते ॥६-२६-३५॥।।
verses.transliteration: na ca samvijate mṛtyor na ca yūthād vidhāvati ।prakampate ca roṣena tiryakca punarīkṣate ॥6-26-35॥।।

translations.english: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."

verses.sloka: पश्यन् लाङ्गूलमपि च क्स्वेडत्येष महाबलः ।महाबलो वीत भयो रम्यम् साल्वेय पर्वतम् ॥६-२६-३६॥।।
verses.transliteration: paśyan lāṅgūlamapi ca ksveḍatyeṣa mahābalaḥ ।mahābalo vīta bhayo ramyam sālveya parvatam ॥6-26-36॥।।

translations.english: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."
translations.hindi: बानरों के बीच वैसे ही बैठा है, जैसे देवताओं के बीच इन्द्र और जिसकी सेना के युद्धाकांची वानरों का महागजन नगाड़ों के शब्द की तरह सुनाई पड़ता है , उत्तस पारियात्र पवत पर रहता है

verses.sloka: राजन् सततम् अध्यास्ते शरभो नाम यूथपः ।एतस्य बलिनः सर्वे विहारा नाम यूथपाः ॥६-२६-३७॥।।
verses.transliteration: rājan satatam adhyāste śarabho nāma yūthapaḥ ।etasya balinaḥ sarve vihārā nāma yūthapāḥ ॥6-26-37॥।।

translations.english: "O King! Under him are forty lakhs of strong warriors known as Viharas."

verses.sloka: राजन् शत सहस्राणि चत्वारिम्शत् तथैव च ।यस् तु मेघ इव आकाशम् महान् आवृत्य तिष्ठति ॥६-२६-३८॥।।
verses.transliteration: rājan śata sahasrāṇi catvārimśat tathaiva ca ।yas tu megha iva ākāśam mahān āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥6-26-38॥।।

translations.english: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

verses.sloka: मध्ये वानर वीराणाम् सुराणाम् इव वासवः ।भेरीणाम् इव सम्नादो यस्य एष श्रूयते महान् ॥६-२६-३९॥।।
verses.transliteration: madhye vānara vīrāṇām surāṇām iva vāsavaḥ ।bherīṇām iva samnādo yasya eṣa śrūyate mahān ॥6-26-39॥।।

translations.english: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

verses.sloka: घोरः शाखा मृग इन्द्राणाम् सम्ग्रामम् अभिकान्क्षताम् ।एष पर्वतम् अध्यास्ते पारियात्रम् अनुत्तमम् ॥६-२६-४०॥।।
verses.transliteration: ghoraḥ śākhā mṛga indrāṇām samgrāmam abhikānkṣatām ।eṣa parvatam adhyāste pāriyātram anuttamam ॥6-26-40॥।।

translations.english: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

verses.sloka: युद्धे दुष्प्रसहो नित्यम् पनसो नाम यूथपः ।एनम् शत सहस्राणाम् शत अर्धम् पर्युपासते ॥६-२६-४१॥।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhe duṣprasaho nityam panaso nāma yūthapaḥ ।enam śata sahasrāṇām śata ardham paryupāsate ॥6-26-41॥।।

translations.english: "Fifty lakhs of best warriors are under him. They are in separate units."

verses.sloka: यूथपा यूथप श्रेष्ठम् येषाम् यूथानि भागशः ।यस् तु भीमाम् प्रवल्गन्तीम् चमूम् तिष्ठति शोभयन् ॥६-२६-४२॥।।
verses.transliteration: yūthapā yūthapa śreṣṭham yeṣām yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ ।yas tu bhīmām pravalgantīm camūm tiṣṭhati śobhayan ॥6-26-42॥।।

translations.english: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."
translations.hindi: युद्ध में इसका वार सहना कठिन है । यह यूथपति है और इसका नाम पनस है। इसके अधीनस्थ डेढ़ लाख वानरवीर ह ४१॥ यूथपा यूथपश्रेष्ठं येपां यूथानि भागशः । यस्तु भौमां प्रवन्गन्ती चसू तिष्ठाति शोभयन्‌

verses.sloka: स्थिताम् तीरे समुद्रस्य द्वितीय इव सागरः ।एष दर्दर सम्काशो विनतो नाम यूथपः ॥६-२६-४३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sthitām tīre samudrasya dvitīya iva sāgaraḥ ।eṣa dardara samkāśo vinato nāma yūthapaḥ ॥6-26-43॥।।

translations.english: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."

verses.sloka: पिबमः चरति पर्णाशाम् नदीनाम् उत्तमाम् नदीम् ।षष्टिः शत सहस्राणि बलम् अस्य प्लवम् गमाः ॥६-२६-४४॥।।
verses.transliteration: pibamaḥ carati parṇāśām nadīnām uttamām nadīm ।ṣaṣṭiḥ śata sahasrāṇi balam asya plavam gamāḥ ॥6-26-44॥।।

translations.english: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."
translations.hindi: यह घूमता फिरता रहता है और सदा नदियों में श्रष्ठ पर्णासा ( पनासा ) नदी का पानी पिया करता हे । इसकी सेना में साठ लाख वानर हें

verses.sloka: त्वाम् आह्वयति युद्धाय क्रथनो नाम यूथपः ।विक्रान्ता बलवन्तश्च यथा यूथानि भागशः ॥६-२६-४५॥।।
verses.transliteration: tvām āhvayati yuddhāya krathano nāma yūthapaḥ ।vikrāntā balavantaśca yathā yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ ॥6-26-45॥।।

translations.english: "The valiant and powerful troop leaders are a part of units of the army under Vanara called Krodhana. He is challenging you for combat."
translations.hindi: यह देखिये क्रोधन नामक यूथपति तुमको युद्ध करने के लिए ललकार रहा है । इसके अधीनस्थ सैनिक बड़े बलवान और पराक्रमी हैं और वे सैनिक यूथों में विभक्त हे

verses.sloka: यस् तु गैरिक वर्ण आभम् वपुः पुष्यति वानरः ।अवमत्य सदा सर्वान्वानरान् बलदर्पितः ॥६-२६-४६॥।।
verses.transliteration: yas tu gairika varṇa ābham vapuḥ puṣyati vānaraḥ ।avamatya sadā sarvānvānarān baladarpitaḥ ॥6-26-46॥।।

translations.english: "He who is of an orange colour body of hand some form, who nourishes it ever and who is proud of his strength, a glorious one known as Gava ya is coming towards you angrily with disregard for Vanaras."
translations.hindi: सके शरीर का रंग गेरू जैसा हे और जो युद्ध करने की आशा से आनन्दित हो अपने शरीर को फुला रहा हे और जो अपने बल के दर्प से दर्पिंत हो , अन्य वानरो को सदा तुच्छ समझा करता हे;

verses.sloka: गवयो नाम तेजस्वी त्वाम् क्रोधाद् अभिवर्तते ।एनम् शत सहस्राणि सप्ततिः पर्युपासते ।एष आशम्सते लंकाम् स्वेन अनीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२६-४७॥।।
verses.transliteration: gavayo nāma tejasvī tvām krodhād abhivartate ।enam śata sahasrāṇi saptatiḥ paryupāsate ।eṣa āśamsate laṁkām svena anīkena marditum ॥6-26-47॥।।

translations.english: "He has seventy lakhs under his command. Single handed with army force is aspiring to crush Lanka."
translations.hindi: पुष्यति- युद्धइर्घादभिबर्धयति ( गो० ) FE ”” a & सप्चविशः सगः २२६ तेजस्वी गवय नामक यूथपति हे । यह क्रोध में भरा हुआ आपका सामना करने की वाट जोह रहा है। इसके अधिकार में सत्तर लाख वीर वानर हैं । यह अकेला ही अपनी सेना के साथ लङ्का को ध्वस्त करना चाहता है

verses.sloka: एते दुष्प्रसहा घोरा बलिनः काम रूपिणः ।यूथपा यूथप श्रेष्ठा येषाम् सम्ख्या न विद्यते ॥६-२६-४८॥
verses.transliteration: ete duṣprasahā ghorā balinaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ ।yūthapā yūthapa śreṣṭhā yeṣām samkhyā na vidyate ॥6-26-48॥

translations.english: "They are difficult to resist, can change their form at will and are strong. These fierce troops, the best of the monkeys, have their units of army force." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषड्विंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: इति षडविशः सगः ॥ हे महाराज ! ये सब के सब दुस्सह, भयङ्कर, बलवान्‌ एवं कासरूपी वानरयूथ और यूथपश्रेष्ठ हें। इनके अधीनस्थ यूथ प्रथक्‌ प्रथक्‌ हैं
